那道代表着天地抹杀意志的紫黑色天雷，也在连续的拼死消耗下，被生生削弱了八九分。
剩下的这部分雷霆，已经没有任何屏障可以阻挡，径直劈在了大明的真龙之躯上。
随后，大明身上那层坚不可摧、散发着金属光泽的青色龙鳞，直接连片炸开。
连带着不少的血肉，都被狂暴的雷霆烧成焦炭。
内里，毁灭的雷霆在它体内肆虐，疯狂吞噬着它的本源。
眼见如此，二明发狂般地怒吼一声。
随后，它迈开粗壮的双腿，就要冲向湖心救援。
它一把按住二明巨大的肩膀，接着空间之力爆发，硬生生将这头十万年泰坦巨猿钉在原地。
“这天劫还未完全散去，气息尚在。
““外人一旦沾染因果，劫云会瞬间将介入者锁定，并视介入者的层次，调整雷劫之威能！”
“你一个十万年魂兽，如果直接闯进去，劫云恐怕还要降下一道至少等同于先前第一道雷罚威力的劫雷！”
“简单的说，你去了，就是让它死得更快！”
话音落下，二明赤红着双眼，双拳死死砸在地上，将地面砸出两个深不见底的大坑。
眼睁睁看着兄弟受难，却无能为力，何其难受呢！
看到这一幕的她，眼泪瞬间夺眶而出。
她和这两只魂兽，从小到大，在她失去母亲后，更是相依为命！
现在看着大明这副濒死凄惨的模样，她的心脏如同被一只大手狠狠攥紧。
要是大明扛不住……想到这里，小舞猛地转头，死死抓住宁天的手。

Volume 1 Chapter 384 The power of God is here (Page 1)
The purple-black sky thunder that represented the will of heaven and earth to wipe out was also weakened by eighty-nine points under the continuous desperate consumption.
The remaining thunderbolt had no barrier to stop it, and it struck directly at Daming's true dragon body.
Then, the indestructible blue dragon scales on Daming's body that exuded metallic luster exploded in succession.
Even a lot of flesh and blood were burned to charcoal by the violent thunder.
Inside, the thunder of destruction raged within its body, devouring its origin crazily.
Seeing this, Er Ming roared like crazy.
Then, it spread its strong legs and rushed to the center of the lake to rescue.
It pressed Er Ming's huge shoulders, and then the power of space exploded, forcibly pinning the 100,000-year-old Titan giant ape in place.
“This heavenly calamity has not completely dissipated, and its aura is still there.
""Once an outsider is contaminated with the cause and effect, the calamity cloud will instantly lock the intervening person, and adjust the power of the thunder calamity depending on the level of the intervening person! "
"You are a hundred thousand year old soul beast. If you break in directly, the calamity cloud will probably rain down a calamity thunder that is at least equal to the power of the first thunder punishment!"
"To put it simply, if you go, you will make it die faster!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Er Ming's eyes were red and he hit the ground with both fists, making two bottomless pits in the ground.
How uncomfortable it is to watch your brother suffer without being able to do anything about it!
Tears instantly burst into her eyes when she saw this scene.
She and these two soul beasts have been dependent on each other since childhood, and even more after she lost her mother!
Now looking at Daming's miserable appearance on the verge of death, her heart felt like it was being clenched tightly by a big hand.
If Daming couldn't bear it... Thinking of this, Xiao Wu suddenly turned her head and grabbed Ning Tian's hand tightly.
